items.item_text: Music Therapist Board Certified (MT-BC) through the Certification Board for Music Therapists (CBMT)
Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or the American Red Cross
Bachelor's degree in Music Therapy or a related field from an accredited institution
Minimum of two (2) years of professional Music Therapy experience
Previous experience working in a hospital or healthcare setting
Experience providing therapeutic services to diverse patient populations within an interdisciplinary healthcare environment

The Music Therapist will provide compassionate music therapy services and deliver culturally sensitive interventions to a pediatric population. This position includes close collaboration with interdisciplinary clinical teams to ensure continuity of care and alignment with program goals. The Music Therapist will document services in accordance with institutional standards.
